about: FFM's GCRF -> ITRF rotation (EarthRotation::matrix with the case export's eop-2026-08 rows) as a type-2 binary PCK for Nyx (make-itrf-bpc.mjs, write_bpc.py). Records tagged with hifitime ET of each UTC sample. Residuals in microarcseconds: fitted = the even 60-s samples the Chebyshev records were fitted to, checked = the odd samples between them, both read back through SPICE pxform; aniseReadBack = every sample read back through ANISE (Nyx).
